deploy._comment_healthcheckTimeout: Sized for the SLOWEST legitimate first boot, not the steady state. A boot that migrates an empty managed Postgres runs ~70 revisions, each a series of DDL round trips; against a cross-region endpoint at ~170ms that alone can pass 100s, and Neon's scale-to-zero adds ~8s before the first statement. Bootstrap runs inside the startup lifespan, so uvicorn accepts no request until it finishes -- a window shorter than the migration kills a deploy that was succeeding. Steady-state boots answer in seconds and never approach this.
